visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The camera captures a wide-angle view of an indoor residential space, specifically a closet area with light beige wooden cabinets. An orange and white tabby cat is lying comfortably inside a light gray fabric cat bed, which is resting on top of a stack of translucent plastic storage bins. The cat’s front left paw dangles relaxedly over the edge of the bed against a backdrop of neatly folded clothes inside the bins. (2) The camera performs a steady and smooth digital zoom in toward the cat's face. The cat remains perfectly still, staring blankly toward the lens with wide, yellowish eyes and a neutral, unblinking expression. The lighting is soft and natural, coming from the side to highlight the texture of the cat's fur and the surrounding storage units. (3) In a tight close-up on the cat's face, a white Chinese character graphic appears over the cat's nose. The cat blinks once slowly while maintaining its vacant gaze. Subsequently, a second line of yellow variety-style text appears below the first, creating a mock dialogue. The cat makes a slight head tilt before the shot ends, remaining in its perched position atop the clothes drawers.
